message:
The vulnerability is about "copying dist bytes with no output bytes written" - this sounds like it's related to miniz (a compression library). Let me look at the build.sh and the miniz directory.

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh && echo "---" && ls -la /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/miniz/</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
